name: commandKit
description: Slash commands for World of Warcraft addons: hyperlink-aware argument parsing, sub-commands with generated usage, output sinks, and in parts schema-checked arguments, tab completion and an OptionsKit command line.
summary: Slash commands with hyperlink-aware parsing, generated usage and sinks; schema-checked arguments, completion and an OptionsKit command line in parts.

Arguments.description: Schema-checked command arguments: SchemaKit schemas per position or one array, coercion of the typed words, generated usage and refusals.

Options.description: Drive an OptionsKit tree from a slash command: the get, set, reset, list and exec verbs and AceConfigCmd's path syntax.

Completion.description: Tab completion in chat edit boxes: the scopes' own commands and AceTab-style completion providers.
